sanskrit: sūtopakḷptān rucirān sadaśvodyatadhūrgatān rathān āsthāya te vīrāḥ sarvapraharaṇānvitāḥ prayāntam ekaṃ kauravyam anusasrur udāyudhāḥ
english: Mounting their splendid chariots yoked by charioteers, drawn by excellent horses straining at the pole, those heroes equipped with every weapon followed the single Kaurava as he set forth, their weapons raised.

sanskrit: tataḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ tasya ca bhārata ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
english: Then, O Bhārata, there arose a tumultuous and hair-raising battle between him alone and those many kings.

sanskrit: te tv iṣūn daśasāhasrāṃs tasmai yugapad ākṣipan aprāptāṃś caiva tān āśu bhīṣmaḥ sarvāṃs tadācchinat
english: They simultaneously let fly ten thousand arrows at him, but Bhīṣma instantly cut down every one of them before they could reach him.

sanskrit: tatas te pārthivāḥ sarve sarvataḥ parivārayan vavarṣuḥ śaravarṣeṇa varṣeṇevādrim ambudāḥ
english: Then all those kings, surrounding him on every side, poured upon him a shower of arrows as storm-clouds rain upon a mountain.

sanskrit: sa tad bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ śarair āvārya sarvataḥ tataḥ sarvān mahīpālān pratyavidhyat tribhis tribhiḥ
english: He intercepted that rain of shafts with his own arrows from every direction, and then pierced all those earth-lords, each with three arrows in return.

sanskrit: tasyāti puruṣān anyāṃl lāghavaṃ rathacāriṇaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ cātmanaḥ saṃkhye śatravo 'py abhyapūjayan
english: Even his enemies marvelled at his superhuman swiftness as a chariot-warrior and at his self-defence in battle.

sanskrit: tān vinirjitya tu raṇe sarvaśastraviśāradaḥ kanyābhiḥ sahitaḥ prāyād bhārato bhāratān prati
english: Having utterly vanquished them in battle, that Bhārata — skilled in all weapons — departed with the maidens toward the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: tatas taṃ pṛṣṭhato rājañ śālvarājo mahārathaḥ abhyāhanad ameyātmā bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ raṇe
english: Then, O king, the great chariot-warrior Śālva's king, immeasurable in spirit, attacked Bhīṣma, son of Shantanu, from behind in battle.

sanskrit: vāraṇaṃ jaghane nighnan dantābhyām aparo yathā vāśitām anusaṃprāpto yūthapo balināṃ varaḥ
english: Like a bull-elephant, foremost among the strong, who has come upon a cow in heat and strikes a rival bull from behind with his tusks.

sanskrit: strīkāma tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bhīṣmam āha sa pārthivaḥ śālvarājo mahābāhur amarṣeṇābhicoditaḥ
english: "O woman-coveter, stand and fight! Stand and fight!" said that king, the great-armed king of Śālva, goaded on by indignation.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa puruṣavyāghro bhīṣmaḥ parabalārdanaḥ tadvākyākulitaḥ krodhād vidhūmo 'gnir iva jvalan
english: Then that tiger among men, Bhīṣma, crusher of enemy forces, stirred by those words, blazed with rage like a smokeless fire.

sanskrit: kṣatradharmaṃ samāsthāya vyapetabhayasaṃbhramaḥ nivartayām āsa rathaṃ śālvaṃ prati mahārathaḥ
english: Abiding by the duty of a warrior, free from fear and agitation, that great chariot-warrior turned his chariot back toward Śālva.

sanskrit: nivartamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānaḥ sarva eva te prekṣakāḥ samapadyanta bhīṣmaśālvasamāgame
english: Seeing him turn back, all those kings became mere spectators at the clash between Bhīṣma and Śālva.

sanskrit: tau vṛṣāv iva nardantau balinau vāśitāntare anyonyam abhivartetāṃ balavikramaśālinau
english: Like two mighty bulls roaring and circling one another over a cow in heat, those two, possessed of great strength and valor, moved against each other.

sanskrit: tato bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ śaraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ śālvarājo naraśreṣṭhaḥ samavākirad āśugaiḥ
english: Then Śālva's king, foremost among men, covered Bhīṣma, son of Shantanu, with hundreds of thousands of swift arrows.

sanskrit: pūrvam abhyarditaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣmaṃ śālvena te nṛpāḥ vismitāḥ samapadyanta sādhu sādhv iti cābruvan
english: Seeing Bhīṣma thus assailed first by Śālva, those kings were astonished and exclaimed "Well done! Well done!"

sanskrit: lāghavaṃ tasya te dṛṣṭvā saṃyuge sarvapārthivāḥ apūjayanta saṃhṛṣṭā vāgbhiḥ śālvaṃ narādhipāḥ
english: Witnessing his swiftness in combat, all those lords of the earth, the kings, joyfully honored Śālva with words of praise.

sanskrit: kṣatriyāṇāṃ tadā vācaḥ śrutvā parapuraṃjayaḥ kruddhaḥ śāṃtanavo bhīṣmas tiṣṭha tiṣṭhety abhāṣata
english: Hearing then the words of the assembled warriors, the enraged Bhīṣma, son of Shantanu — conqueror of enemy cities — cried out, "Stand! Stand!"

sanskrit: sārathiṃ cābravīt kruddho yāhi yatraiṣa pārthivaḥ yāvad enaṃ nihanmy adya bhujaṃgam iva pakṣirāṭ
english: And in his fury he spoke to his charioteer: "Drive where that king stands, that I may today slay him as the king of birds slays a serpent."

sanskrit: tato 'straṃ vāruṇaṃ samyag yojayām āsa kauravaḥ tenāśvāṃś caturo 'mṛdnāc chālvarājño narādhipa
english: Then the Kaurava duly invoked the Varuṇa weapon, O lord of men, and with it he crushed the four horses of Śālva's king.

sanskrit: astrair astrāṇi saṃvārya śālvarājñaḥ sa kauravaḥ bhīṣmo nṛpatiśārdūla nyavadhīt tasya sārathim astreṇa cāpy athaikena nyavadhīt turagottamān
english: Warding off the weapons of Śālva's king with his own weapons, that Kaurava Bhīṣma, O tiger among kings, slew Śālva's charioteer, and with a single weapon further struck down his finest horses.

sanskrit: kanyāhetor naraśreṣṭha bhīṣmaḥ śāṃtanavas tadā jitvā visarjayām āsa jīvantaṃ nṛpasattamam tataḥ śālvaḥ svanagaraṃ prayayau bharatarṣabha
english: For the sake of the maidens, O best of men, Bhīṣma, son of Shantanu, having vanquished him, then released that foremost of kings alive; and Śālva departed to his own city, O bull of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: rājāno ye ca tatrāsan svayaṃvaradidṛkṣavaḥ svāny eva te 'pi rāṣṭrāṇi jagmuḥ parapuraṃjaya
english: And those kings who had been present there, wishing to witness the svayamvara, likewise returned to their own kingdoms, O conqueror of enemy cities.

sanskrit: evaṃ vijitya tāḥ kanyā bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ prayayau hāstinapuraṃ yatra rājā sa kauravaḥ
english: Having thus won those maidens, Bhīṣma, foremost among warriors, proceeded to Hāstinapura, where the Kaurava king resided.

sanskrit: so 'cireṇaiva kālena atyakrāman narādhipa vanāni saritaś caiva śailāṃś ca vividhadrumān
english: In no long time, O lord of men, he traversed forests, rivers, and mountains adorned with manifold trees.

sanskrit: akṣataḥ kṣapayitvārīn saṃkhye 'saṃkhyeyavikramaḥ ānayām āsa kāśyasya sutāḥ sāgaragāsutaḥ
english: Uninjured himself, having destroyed his foes in battle — he whose valor was beyond measure — the son of the river Gaṅgā brought home the daughters of the king of Kāśi.

sanskrit: snuṣā iva sa dharmātmā bhaginya iva cānujāḥ yathā duhitaraś caiva pratigṛhya yayau kurūn
english: That righteous-souled one received them as daughters-in-law, as younger sisters, and as daughters, and escorted them to the Kurus.

sanskrit: tāḥ sarvā guṇasaṃpannā bhrātā bhrātre yavīyase bhīṣmo vicitravīryāya pradadau vikramāhṛtāḥ
english: All of them endowed with virtues, won by his valor — Bhīṣma, as a brother, gave them to his younger brother Vicitravīrya.

sanskrit: satāṃ dharmeṇa dharmajñaḥ kṛtvā karmātimānuṣam bhrātur vicitravīryasya vivāhāyopacakrame satyavatyā saha mithaḥ kṛtvā niścayam ātmavān
english: The righteous Bhīṣma, knowing the law of the virtuous, having accomplished that superhuman deed, set about arranging the marriage of his brother Vicitravīrya, having resolved the matter together with Satyavatī, self-possessed as he was.

sanskrit: vivāhaṃ kārayiṣyantaṃ bhīṣmaṃ kāśipateḥ sutā jyeṣṭhā tāsām idaṃ vākyam abravīd dha satī tadā
english: As Bhīṣma was arranging the marriage, the eldest daughter of the king of Kāśi, that virtuous woman, then spoke these words:

sanskrit: mayā saubhapatiḥ pūrvaṃ manasābhivṛtaḥ patiḥ tena cāsmi vṛtā pūrvam eṣa kāmaś ca me pituḥ
english: "The lord of Saubha has already been chosen by me in my heart as my husband, and he too had already chosen me — and this was also my father's wish."

sanskrit: mayā varayitavyo 'bhūc chālvas tasmin svayaṃvare etad vijñāya dharmajña tatas tvaṃ dharmam ācara
english: "Śālva was to have been chosen by me at that svayamvara. Knowing this, O knower of dharma, do now what is right."

sanskrit: evam uktas tayā bhīṣmaḥ kanyayā viprasaṃsadi cintām abhyagamad vīro yuktāṃ tasyaiva karmaṇaḥ
english: Thus addressed by that maiden in the assembly of brahmins, the heroic Bhīṣma fell into fitting reflection regarding what was to be done in this matter.

sanskrit: sa viniścitya dharmajño brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ anujajñe tadā jyeṣṭām ambāṃ kāśipateḥ sutām
english: Having deliberated with brahmins who had crossed to the further shore of the Vedas, the knower of dharma then gave leave to the eldest, Amba, daughter of the king of Kāśi.

sanskrit: ambikāmbālike bhārye prādād bhrātre yavīyase bhīṣmo vicitravīryāya vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
english: Bhīṣma gave Ambikā and Ambalika as wives to his younger brother Vicitravīrya according to the rites prescribed by tradition.

sanskrit: tayoḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhītvā sa rūpayauvanadarpitaḥ vicitravīryo dharmātmā kāmātmā samapadyata
english: Taking the hand of each of them, Vicitravīrya, the righteous-souled one, proud of his beauty and youth, became possessed by desire.

sanskrit: te cāpi bṛhatī śyāme nīlakuñcitamūrdhaje raktatuṅganakhopete pīnaśroṇipayodhare
english: And they too were tall, dark, with blue curling hair, with reddish and prominent nails, and with full hips and breasts —

sanskrit: ātmanaḥ pratirūpo 'sau labdhaḥ patir iti sthite vicitravīryaṃ kalyāṇaṃ pūjayām āsatus tu te
english: Certain that they had obtained a husband well-matched to themselves, both honored the auspicious Vicitravīrya.

sanskrit: sa cāśvirūpasadṛśo devasattvaparākramaḥ sarvāsām eva nārīṇāṃ cittapramathano 'bhavat
english: And he, resembling the Aśvins in beauty, with the valor and spirit of the gods, became a captivator of the hearts of all women.

sanskrit: tābhyāṃ saha samāḥ sapta viharan pṛthivīpatiḥ vicitravīryas taruṇo yakṣmāṇaṃ samapadyata
english: Sporting with those two for seven years, the young lord of the earth, Vicitravīrya, fell ill with consumption.

sanskrit: suhṛdāṃ yatamānānām āptaiḥ saha cikitsakaiḥ jagāmāstam ivādityaḥ kauravyo yamasādanam
english: Despite the efforts of his friends and trusted physicians, that Kaurava went to Yama's abode like the sun setting.

sanskrit: pretakāryāṇi sarvāṇi tasya samyag akārayat rājño vicitravīryasya satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ sahito bhīṣmaḥ sarvaiś ca kurupuṃgavaiḥ
english: Acting in accordance with Satyavatī's wishes, Bhīṣma, together with the officiating priests and all the foremost Kurus, duly performed all the funeral rites for King Vicitravīrya.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ satyavatī dīnā kṛpaṇā putragṛddhinī putrasya kṛtvā kāryāṇi snuṣābhyāṃ saha bhārata
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Satyavatī, sorrowful, pitiable, yearning for a son, having performed the funeral duties for her son together with her daughters-in-law, O Bhārata —

sanskrit: dharmaṃ ca pitṛvaṃśaṃ ca mātṛvaṃśaṃ ca māninī prasamīkṣya mahābhāgā gāṅgeyaṃ vākyam abravīt
english: — that honored and greatly blessed woman, reflecting carefully on dharma, the paternal lineage, and the maternal lineage, spoke these words to the son of Gaṅgā:

sanskrit: śaṃtanor dharmanityasya kauravyasya yaśasvinaḥ tvayi piṇḍaś ca kīrtiś ca saṃtānaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitam
english: "In you rests the ancestral offering, the fame, and the continuity of Shantanu, the ever-righteous Kaurava of great renown.

sanskrit: yathā karma śubhaṃ kṛtvā svargopagamanaṃ dhruvam yathā cāyur dhruvaṃ satye tvayi dharmas tathā dhruvaḥ
english: As ascent to heaven is assured upon doing virtuous deeds, as life is assured in truth, so dharma is assured in you.

sanskrit: vettha dharmāṃś ca dharmajña samāsenetareṇa ca vividhās tvaṃ śrutīr vettha vettha vedāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: You know the various duties of dharma both in summary and in detail, O knower of dharma; you know the diverse revealed scriptures and all the Vedas in their entirety.

sanskrit: vyavasthānaṃ ca te dharme kulācāraṃ ca lakṣaye pratipattiṃ ca kṛcchreṣu śukrāṅgirasayor iva
english: I see in you steadfastness in dharma, adherence to family custom, and conduct in difficult situations like that of Śukra and Aṅgiras.

sanskrit: tasmāt subhṛśam āśvasya tvayi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara kārye tvāṃ viniyokṣyāmi tac chrutvā kartum arhasi
english: Therefore, O best of those who uphold dharma, I shall set you, greatly reassured, to a task; hear it and you ought to carry it out.

sanskrit: mama putras tava bhrātā vīryavān supriyaś ca te bāla eva gataḥ svargam aputraḥ puruṣarṣabha
english: My son, your brother, the valiant one who was so dear to you, has gone to heaven even as a boy, without a son, O bull among men.

sanskrit: ime mahiṣyau bhrātus te kāśirājasute śubhe rūpayauvanasaṃpanne putrakāme ca bhārata
english: These two queens of your brother, O Bhārata — the fair daughters of the king of Kāśi, endowed with beauty and youth and longing for sons —

sanskrit: tayor utpādayāpatyaṃ saṃtānāya kulasya naḥ manniyogān mahābhāga dharmaṃ kartum ihārhasi
english: — you ought, O greatly blessed one, to beget offspring upon them at my command, for the perpetuation of our lineage; it is your duty to do so here.

sanskrit: rājye caivābhiṣicyasva bhāratān anuśādhi ca dārāṃś ca kuru dharmeṇa mā nimajjīḥ pitāmahān
english: Be consecrated in the kingdom, govern the Bhāratas, take wives according to dharma — do not let our ancestors sink down."

sanskrit: tathocyamāno mātrā ca suhṛdbhiś ca paraṃtapaḥ pratyuvāca sa dharmātmā dharmyam evottaraṃ vacaḥ
english: Thus addressed by his mother and by his friends, that scorcher of enemies, the righteous-souled one, gave in reply only a righteous answer:

sanskrit: asaṃśayaṃ paro dharmas tvayā mātar udāhṛtaḥ tvam apatyaṃ prati ca me pratijñāṃ vettha vai parām
english: "Without doubt, O mother, you have stated a highest duty; and you know well the supreme vow I took regarding offspring.

sanskrit: jānāsi ca yathāvṛttaṃ śulkahetos tvadantare sa satyavati satyaṃ te pratijānāmy ahaṃ punaḥ
english: You know what happened in your presence for the sake of the bride-price, O Satyavatī; I swear to you the truth again:

sanskrit: parityajeyaṃ trailokyaṃ rājyaṃ deveṣu vā punaḥ yad vāpy adhikam etābhyāṃ na tu satyaṃ kathaṃ cana
english: I would renounce the three worlds, or a kingdom among the gods, or whatever else might surpass even these — but I would never in any way abandon truth.

sanskrit: tyajec ca pṛthivī gandham āpaś ca rasam ātmanaḥ jyotis tathā tyajed rūpaṃ vāyuḥ sparśaguṇaṃ tyajet
english: The earth might abandon its smell, water might abandon its own taste, fire might abandon its form, wind might abandon its quality of touch —

sanskrit: prabhāṃ samutsṛjed arko dhūmaketus tathoṣṇatām tyajec chabdaṃ tathākāśaḥ somaḥ śītāṃśutāṃ tyajet
english: The sun might cast off its radiance, the comet its heat, space might abandon sound, the moon might cast off its coolness —

sanskrit: vikramaṃ vṛtrahā jahyād dharmaṃ jahyāc ca dharmarāṭ na tv ahaṃ satyam utsraṣṭuṃ vyavaseyaṃ kathaṃ cana
english: The slayer of Vṛtra might abandon his valor, the king of dharma his righteousness — but I could never in any way be resolved to abandon truth."

sanskrit: evam uktā tu putreṇa bhūridraviṇatejasā mātā satyavatī bhīṣmam uvāca tadanantaram
english: Thus addressed by her son of immeasurable wealth and brilliance, mother Satyavatī then spoke again to Bhīṣma:

sanskrit: jānāmi te sthitiṃ satye parāṃ satyaparākrama icchan sṛjethās trīṃl lokān anyāṃs tvaṃ svena tejasā
english: "I know your supreme steadfastness in truth, O you whose valor is your truth; if you wished, you could by your own power create three other worlds.

sanskrit: jānāmi caiva satyaṃ tan madarthaṃ yad abhāṣathāḥ āpaddharmam avekṣasva vaha paitāmahīṃ dhuram
english: I know too that what you have spoken is truth, and you spoke it for my sake; but consider the dharma of emergencies — bear the ancestral burden.

sanskrit: yathā te kulatantuś ca dharmaś ca na parābhavet suhṛdaś ca prahṛṣyeraṃs tathā kuru paraṃtapa
english: Act, O scorcher of foes, in such a way that neither the family line nor dharma may come to ruin, and that your friends may rejoice."

sanskrit: lālapyamānāṃ tām evaṃ kṛpaṇāṃ putragṛddhinīm dharmād apetaṃ bruvatīṃ bhīṣmo bhūyo 'bravīd idam
english: As she lamented thus, pitiable and yearning for a son, speaking what deviated from dharma, Bhīṣma spoke once more to her:

sanskrit: rājñi dharmān avekṣasva mā naḥ sarvān vyanīnaśaḥ satyāc cyutiḥ kṣatriyasya na dharmeṣu praśasyate
english: "O queen, look to the laws of dharma — do not lead us all to ruin; departure from truth is not praised in the codes of dharma for a warrior.

sanskrit: śaṃtanor api saṃtānaṃ yathā syād akṣayaṃ bhuvi tat te dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi kṣātraṃ rājñi sanātanam
english: I will declare to you, O queen, the eternal warrior dharma by which Shantanu's lineage may endure imperishably on earth.

sanskrit: śrutvā taṃ pratipadyethāḥ prājñaiḥ saha purohitaiḥ āpaddharmārthakuśalair lokatantram avekṣya ca
english: Having heard it, you should act upon it together with the wise men and the priest, who are skilled in the dharma of emergencies and in practical matters, having regard also for the ways of the world."

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa pitur vadham amṛṣyatā kruddhena ca mahābhāge haihayādhipatir hataḥ śatāni daśa bāhūnāṃ nikṛttāny arjunasya vai
english: Bhīṣma said: O greatly blessed one, by Rāma son of Jamadagni, who could not endure his father's slaying and was consumed with wrath, the lord of the Haihayas was slain, and the thousand arms of Arjuna were hewn off.

sanskrit: punaś ca dhanur ādāya mahāstrāṇi pramuñcatā nirdagdhaṃ kṣatram asakṛd rathena jayatā mahīm
english: And again, taking up his bow and releasing great weapons, conquering the earth with his chariot, he burned the warrior class not just once.

sanskrit: evam uccāvacair astrair bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī kṛtā niḥkṣatriyā purā
english: Thus, with various high and low weapons, the great-souled Bhārgava once made the earth devoid of warriors twenty-one times over.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃbhūya sarvābhiḥ kṣatriyābhiḥ samantataḥ utpāditāny apatyāni brāhmaṇair niyatātmabhiḥ
english: Thereupon, coming together from all directions, those warrior-women had children fathered upon them by self-controlled brahmins.

sanskrit: pāṇigrāhasya tanaya iti vedeṣu niścitam dharmaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya brāhmaṇāṃs tāḥ samabhyayuḥ loke 'py ācarito dṛṣṭaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ punarbhavaḥ
english: "The son belongs to him who took the hand" — this is established in the Vedas; with that dharma fixed in their minds, those women approached the brahmins; and in the world too this rebirth of the warrior class is seen to have been practiced.

sanskrit: athotathya iti khyāta āsīd dhīmān ṛṣiḥ purā mamatā nāma tasyāsīd bhāryā paramasaṃmatā
english: Now, there was in ancient times a wise sage known by the name of Utathya, and his wife was named Mamata, held in the highest esteem.

sanskrit: utathyasya yavīyāṃs tu purodhās tridivaukasām bṛhaspatir bṛhattejā mamatāṃ so 'nvapadyata
english: But Utathya's younger brother, Bṛhaspati, the great-souled, the preceptor of the dwellers in the third heaven, approached Mamata with desire.

sanskrit: uvāca mamatā taṃ tu devaraṃ vadatāṃ varam antarvatnī ahaṃ bhrātrā jyeṣṭhenāramyatām iti
english: Mamata said to that brother-in-law, foremost among speakers: "I am pregnant by my elder brother-in-law; let it rest — do not proceed."

sanskrit: ayaṃ ca me mahābhāga kukṣāv eva bṛhaspate autathyo vedam atraiva ṣaḍaṅgaṃ pratyadhīyata
english: "And this child of mine, O greatly blessed Bṛhaspati, the son of Utathya, is even now in my womb reciting the Veda together with its six ancillaries here."

sanskrit: amogharetās tvaṃ cāpi nūnaṃ bhavitum arhasi tasmād evaṃgate 'dya tvam upāramitum arhasi
english: "Your seed too is never fruitless — you ought indeed to be so; therefore, given all this, you ought today to desist."

sanskrit: evam uktas tayā samyag bṛhattejā bṛhaspatiḥ kāmātmānaṃ tadātmānaṃ na śaśāka niyacchitum
english: Though thus properly addressed by her, the great-souled Bṛhaspati could not restrain his own self, then so given over to desire.

sanskrit: saṃbabhūva tataḥ kāmī tayā sārdham akāmayā utsṛjantaṃ tu taṃ retaḥ sa garbhastho 'bhyabhāṣata
english: Then he, consumed by desire, lay with her who did not desire it; and as he was releasing his seed, the child in the womb spoke to him.
